findings.description: Calling `.strip()` also removes intentional whitespace from the prompt, including the trailing space that separates the prompt from the answer. ANSI removal should preserve that whitespace.
findings.rationale: When stdout is redirected or otherwise requires ANSI stripping, a normal prompt such as `"Name: "` becomes `"Name:"`. Leading indentation and whitespace-only prompts are also removed, changing the displayed prompt even when it contains no ANSI codes.
